final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no genuinely new admissible evidence. Their response is a tighter interpretation of the same evidence and appropriately retreats from any clean-certification claim. That clarification matters, but it is not enough to convert the record to compliant_with_caveats. Under the stated policy, certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible record still shows the opposite: a remaining named-use-case weakness, a draft mitigation artifact with missing approval-critical fields, and model-card language that currently understates the limitation. A caveated position could become compliant if the limitation were actually disclosed in final model-card language or covered by approved risk acceptance, but that predicate is not yet evidenced here. The remaining issue is therefore substantive, not merely presentational.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided after the initial report; the Actor mainly narrowed and clarified the position using the same record.
The current record still shows an unresolved below-target issue in a named launch use case, concentrated in observation-status coding guidance.
The mitigation artifact remains draft and still lacks the policy-required owner and alert threshold; policy also requires review date and rollback criterion for approval-quality mitigation.
The model-card draft still contains unsupported 'no known material limitations' language, and no final corrected disclosure text is in evidence.
No approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
Because disclosure or approved mitigation is still an unresolved compliance predicate on the current record, caveated certification is not yet demonstrated as compliant.
